records.context: Torch, scikit-learn, and XGBoost wheels can load independent LLVM OpenMP runtimes into one process. Crossing their background execution unit state can terminate the process, particularly when ``KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK`` suppresses the runtime's duplicate-initialization guard.
records.label: spacr.openmp_guard#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Torch, scikit-learn, and XGBoost wheels can load independent LLVM OpenMP runtimes into one process. Crossing their worker-thread state can terminate the process, particularly when ``KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK`` suppresses the runtime's duplicate-initialization guard.
records.translation: Wheels för Torch, scikit-learn och XGBoost kan ladda oberoende LLVM OpenMP-körtidsmiljöer i en och samma process. När deras tillstånd för arbetstrådar korsas kan processen avslutas, särskilt när ``KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK`` undertrycker körtidsmiljöns skydd mot dubbel initiering.

records.context: :func:`single_threaded_openmp` detects mapped runtimes and, when more than one is resident, calls ``omp_set_num_threads(1)`` on the fitting independent execution path. This serializes that independent execution path's parallel regions without imposing a process-wide ``OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`` limit on segmentation and other workloads. Estimator ``n_jobs`` and ``nthread`` arguments are not substitutes because they do not prevent the OpenMP runtime from creating a worker team.
records.label: spacr.openmp_guard#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: :func:`single_threaded_openmp` detects mapped runtimes and, when more than one is resident, calls ``omp_set_num_threads(1)`` on the fitting thread. This serializes that thread's parallel regions without imposing a process-wide ``OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`` limit on segmentation and other workloads. Estimator ``n_jobs`` and ``nthread`` arguments are not substitutes because they do not prevent the OpenMP runtime from creating a worker team.
records.translation: :func:`single_threaded_openmp` upptäcker inlästa körtidsmiljöer och anropar, när fler än en finns, ``omp_set_num_threads(1)`` på anpassningstråden. Detta serialiserar den trådens parallella regioner utan att införa en processövergripande gräns ``OMP_NUM_THREADS=1`` för segmentering och andra arbetslaster. Estimatorns argument ``n_jobs`` och ``nthread`` ersätter inte detta, eftersom de inte hindrar OpenMP-körtidsmiljön från att skapa ett team av arbetstrådar.

records.context: The clamp is a per-independent execution path ICV, so a joblib background execution unit starts with the process default (10 here, not 1) and builds a team the region was supposed to prevent. Measured on this repository's own ``ml_analysis``: 19 independent execution paths parked in ``__kmp_launch_worker`` unguarded, still 10 with only the region clamp, and those 10 belong to Homebrew's libomp — xgboost's runtime, the one that crashed. Keeping joblib on the calling independent execution path keeps the clamp meaningful.
records.label: spacr.openmp_guard.guarded_n_jobs#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The clamp is a per-thread ICV, so a joblib worker thread starts with the process default (10 here, not 1) and builds a team the region was supposed to prevent. Measured on this repository's own ``ml_analysis``: 19 threads parked in ``__kmp_launch_worker`` unguarded, still 10 with only the region clamp, and those 10 belong to Homebrew's libomp — xgboost's runtime, the one that crashed. Keeping joblib on the calling thread keeps the clamp meaningful.
records.translation: Begränsningen är en ICV per tråd, så en joblib-arbetstråd startar med processens standardvärde (10 här, inte 1) och bygger ett team som regionen skulle förhindra. Uppmätt på det här kodförrådets egen ``ml_analysis``: 19 trådar parkerade i ``__kmp_launch_worker`` utan skydd, fortfarande 10 med enbart regionens begränsning, och de 10 tillhör Homebrews libomp — xgboosts körtidsmiljö, den som kraschade. Att hålla joblib på den anropande tråden gör att begränsningen behåller sin betydelse.
